proofs.title: Semantic matrix and runner contract tests
Seeded Raft failover and nemesis tests
Local backend public API and authority tests
Real six-node write-scaling and Raft failover harness

dimensions.title: Serializable mutations with owner-side OCC validation
dimensions.currentEvidence: Owner-read races, bank/register invariants, retry behavior, and a seeded single-node Elle model are executable.
dimensions.gap: Elle is not yet driving the real multi-partition cluster, and node-local system-table writes can still bypass complete owner validation.

dimensions.title: Atomic visibility for multi-partition transactions and reads
dimensions.currentEvidence: 2PC recovery, participant fencing, and cluster cross-partition mutation scenarios are executable.
dimensions.gap: The cluster does not yet derive one safe snapshot that proves all required owners have resolved through the same logical version.

dimensions.title: Portable read-after-write tokens and cursors across routing and failover
dimensions.currentEvidence: Participant-aware read-after-write token parsing, waiting, routing, and Docker continuity checks are executable.
dimensions.gap: Tokens are not yet backed by a cluster-wide safe snapshot proof that remains portable through every leader and placement change.

dimensions.title: Gap-free reactive invalidation and consistent subscription reruns
dimensions.currentEvidence: Prepared-write invalidation timing and public subscription authority behavior have regression tests.
dimensions.gap: Owner-sharded dependency registration, registration-gap replay, common-snapshot reruns, and subscription failover are not implemented.

dimensions.title: Stable document and table identity across nodes and lifecycle events
dimensions.currentEvidence: Global table-number allocation and embedded document-ID replication have executable tests.
dimensions.gap: Identity has not been proven through online placement movement, globally consistent backup, and restore.

dimensions.title: Topology-transparent public APIs and equivalent errors
dimensions.currentEvidence: Route authority, mutation forwarding, leader routing, and fail-closed public API behavior are executable.
dimensions.gap: Several coordinator-owned surfaces still reject rather than transparently forward, and authority retry is not complete for every live candidate.

dimensions.title: One deployment, schema, component, and index catalog version per request
dimensions.currentEvidence: Catalog parse failures, owner routing, index metadata replication, and deploy smoke behavior have tests.
dimensions.gap: Catalog artifacts are not staged and activated as one immutable cluster-wide version.

dimensions.title: Singleton and fenced background work across leadership handoff
dimensions.currentEvidence: Worker startup policy and coordinator authority are executable for currently enabled surfaces.
dimensions.gap: Disabled workers lack ownership protocols, and scheduled external side effects are not fenced through leadership handoff.

dimensions.title: Fail-closed behavior for authority, apply, replication, and transaction gaps
dimensions.currentEvidence: No-quorum writes, Raft nemeses, NATS outage, authentication, redelivery, and several recovery windows have executable tests.
dimensions.gap: Canonical bootstrap, applied-prefix serving, crash-idempotent replay, bound snapshots, and poison-gap quarantine remain open.

dimensions.title: Globally consistent backup, export, and verified restore
dimensions.currentEvidence: Fresh-replica checkpoint bootstrap, snapshot catch-up, and import/export authority behavior have regression coverage.
dimensions.gap: There is no manifest that pins all partitions, placement, and catalog state to one safe snapshot and verifies restore equivalence.

dimensions.title: Safe node membership changes and replacement
dimensions.currentEvidence: Membership refresh, failover, lagging-follower catch-up, and restart scenarios are executable.
dimensions.gap: Raft learner promotion, joint consensus, decommissioning, and clock-skew-safe liveness are not implemented.

dimensions.title: Versioned placement movement without split authority or topology leaks
dimensions.currentEvidence: Static placement-version rejection, refresh, routing, and membership-address discovery have tests.
dimensions.gap: Snapshot-copy, catch-up, write fencing, atomic epoch switch, draining, splitting, and rebalancing are not implemented.
